116-2645-3230-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1409-7818-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

4775-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

328-3260-4078-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-4078-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-4078-5231.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

4863-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Revolutionist
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Revolutionist
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2438-3605-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-969-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-4865--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Vesuvan Shapeshifter that has haste. Choose to have Vesuvan Shapeshifter enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Vesuvan Shapeshifter token instead.
618-4865--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Vesuvan Shapeshifter's toughness.

176-2511-3000.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2511-3000.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1682-1753-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-1753-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3062-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

985-1492-4195-4574.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
985-1492-4195-4574.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2459-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

5641-5662-5805.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5641-5662-5805.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
Repeat from step 3.

4636-4772-5770-6753.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

725-971-6702.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3967-6243-6288.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

575-2034-5971.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
575-2034-5971.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When the creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Repeat.

2438-5853-5929.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2438-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1379-4050-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1379-4050-5433.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Repeat.

628-1365-1636-2292-4916.notablePrerequisites:
Animate Artifact attached to Cauldron of Souls.
Cauldron of Souls does not have summoning sickness.
628-1365-1636-2292-4916.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing itself.
When Viscera Seer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature persist until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing itself.
When Viscera Seer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

450-2233.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter.
{4}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
450-2233.description:
Cast Iname either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{B}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Iname enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for any number of Spirit cards and put them into your graveyard.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter form it, putting all Spirits put into your graveyard this turn onto the battlefield under your control.

338-1545-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
338-1545-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth equal to the amount of life gained.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-1358-4222.notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1358-4222.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.
